protocol.counterexample_construction: P=1; m=2^(3k); K={m/2}; epsilon=2^-k; tau=1/8; delta=1/4; query first k ranks then census fallback
protocol.profile_construction: m=ceil(N*4*tau*log_upper(4/delta)/(P*epsilon^2)); product-prior p=tau-2epsilon, q=p+12epsilon; kappa=256epsilon^2/tau; band cap B=ceil(log(1/delta)/(2kappa))
protocol.status: Fixed after exploratory proof and separate agent review, before the saved broader calculation; not external preregistration

theorem.objective: One globally delta-valid, all-safe-complete auditor; worst-case expected distinct labels over fixed tables with max R_n <= tau-epsilon
theorem.prefix_upper: P*k_epsilon, where k_epsilon is the shortest prefix with C(m-k,min(K))/C(m,min(K))<=epsilon
theorem.scope: Arbitrary nonempty declared grids; global certification, fixed labels, supplied margin. No universal min(census,Z*tau*log(1/delta)/epsilon^2) lower law.

rounding.information: Lower information uses L_lo, log(5/4)_hi, log(2)_hi; upper information uses the upper integer cap.
rounding.log_five_fourths: Wrapper takes reciprocal argument 4/5 and subtracts log4 bounds from log5 bounds outward.
